body.name: Relevant-component forest/unicycle handle
body.construction: Given an explicit instance, compute the weak components of the underlying undirected full graph and let \(C_X\) and \(C_Y\) contain \(X\) and \(Y\).  If \(C_X\ne C_Y\), \(\operatorname{UnicycleHandle}\) returns the weak-component separating cut.  If \(C_X=C_Y=C\) and \(C\) has cycle rank zero, it first computes directed reachability from \(X\) in \(G[C]\): when \(Y\) is unreachable it returns that directed-reachability cut and value \(+\infty\), and only when \(Y\) is reachable does it invoke the value-path compiler on the unique directed path.  If the common component has cycle rank one, it cuts the unique factor-graph cycle at a boundary variable and carries the exceptional-edge mode---shortcut retained, complementary arc already broken, or one specified repair edge---jointly with the local nonactual-value state.  Every other weak component is retained at its actual assignment.
